summary: At Tsinghua, follow the course AI norm, disclose AI use, keep sensitive or classified data out of AI operations, and do not copy AI output or use it to ghostwrite graduate theses; Xiaoda’s listing is not assessment permission.

dimensions.summary: Tsinghua prohibits directly copying or mechanically paraphrasing AI output as coursework and asks instructors to state course norms. Scope: official education principles and course guidance.

do: Read the course AI norm and keep your work independently produced.
dont: Do not submit copied or mechanically paraphrased AI output as coursework.

dimensions.summary: No source-backed student exam-specific rule is included; this is not evidence of permission or prohibition.
Tsinghua requires teachers and students to disclose AI use and AI-generated content in accordance with regulations. Scope: official education principles.

do: Follow the applicable disclosure requirement for AI use or output.
dont: Do not conceal AI use where the regulations require disclosure.

dimensions.summary: Tsinghua prohibits use of sensitive, classified, or unauthorized data to train or operate AI models. Scope: official education principles.

do: Keep sensitive and classified data out of AI operations unless expressly authorized.
dont: Do not enter unauthorized or classified data into an AI model.

dimensions.summary: Tsinghua official material lists Xiaoda as an institutional AI service. Listing or provision is not permission for a specific course, exam, thesis, or research task.

do: Check eligibility and the course or project rule before using Xiaoda.
dont: Do not infer assessment permission from the service listing.

dimensions.summary: Tsinghua prohibits AI-assisted ghostwriting, plagiarism, and fabrication in graduate theses and requires supervisory oversight. Scope: graduate training and theses.

do: Follow supervisor guidance and keep thesis work original.
dont: Do not use AI to replace required independent academic training or ghostwrite a thesis.
